Please upgrade. 90 minutes of unfiltered product advice from Snap and Discord’s product chief | Peter Sellis Peter Sellis on designing teams like terrorist organizations, riding your best people hard, and the three oxymorons of a truly great PM Lenny Rachitsky Sep 20, 2026 ∙ Paid 131 3 Share Transcript Peter Sellis was the first product manager at Snapchat, where he spent seven years building one of the most beloved consumer products in history. He went on to serve as Head of Product at Discord, where he helped drive some of the fastest user growth the platform had seen. Having left his role at Discord, he gets to be especially real and unfiltered — nothing to promote, no PR, no comms team. Listen on YouTube , Spotify , and Apple Podcasts In our in-depth conversation, we discuss: Why Peter designs teams like . . . terrorist organizations What it was really like to manage Nikita Bier Why
